definitions.gloss: to use up completely, to exhaust
definitions.explanation: To consume or spend something entirely so that none remains.

examples.japanese: ポイントを{使|つか}い{切|き}った。
examples.english: I used up all my points.

examples.japanese: {食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}い{切|き}ってから{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go shopping after using up all the ingredients.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{使|つか}い{切|き}らないと{来年|らいねん}の{予算|よさん}が{減|へ}らされる。
examples.english: If we don't use up the budget, next year's budget will be cut.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {使|つか}う (to use) + {切|き}る (to cut/finish completely). The {切|き}る suffix indicates doing something thoroughly or to completion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{予算|よさん}を{使|つか}い{切|き}る (use up the budget)
・{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}い{切|き}る (use up the ingredients)
・{体力|たいりょく}を{使|つか}い{切|き}る (exhaust one's stamina)
・ポイントを{使|つか}い{切|き}る (use up points)
